title: Corrigendum to Council Framework Decision 2003/577/JHA of 22 July 2003 on the execution in the European Union of orders freezing property or evidence ( OJ L 196, 2.8.2003 )
text:
27.12.2006
EN
Official Journal of the European Union
L 374/20
Corrigendum to Council Framework Decision 2003/577/JHA of 22 July 2003 on the execution in the European Union of orders freezing property or evidence
(
Official Journal of the European Union L 196 of 2 August 2003
)
On page 46, in Article 2 ‘Definitions’, in point c:
for:
‘(c)
“freezing order” property that could be subject to confiscation or evidence;’,
read:
‘(c)
“freezing order” shall mean any measure taken by a competent judicial authority in the issuing State in order provisionally to prevent the destruction, transformation, moving, transfer or disposal of property that could be subject to confiscation or evidence;’.
